label: PF Backlog 180
title: Role-driven knowledge compliance + OSS/HF knowledge sourcing
body: Make knowledge-compliant validation ROLE-driven: assert each agent's output complies with ITS declared knowledge domains + skills (from agent-capabilities/knowledge_layers), not content-detected layers alone (knowledge_compliance_checker._detect_layers_from_artifacts). Where a role's knowledge domain is missing from docs/guidelines, SOURCE it from open-source/HuggingFace (with provenance + license), register it, and use it for the role check. Keep the structural AGENT_CHECKLISTS + derived floor as the structural layer.

dashboard_impact.reason: Knowledge/role view in the dashboard (agents window).

_note: knowledge_compliance_checker.check_agent_compliance now merges the agent's DECLARED knowledge domains (agent-capabilities + registry) into the checked layers and sets role_layers + role_missing (declared layers with no guidelines => needs sourcing, the OSS/HuggingFace hook). Verified on 0c researcher.
